content.text:
Resubmitted with the duration defect cured.

**What changed:** the revised replacement strikes the standing "During the Term of this Agreement and" limb entirely, so the covenant now runs from a single anchor — "During the twelve (12) month period after the end of that person's involvement in the services provided under this Agreement" — and cannot extend past 12 months after an individual's involvement ends. The same operation keeps the covenant mutual ("neither party"), limits it to persons "who is or was directly involved in such services", and retains solicitation-to-leave only (no no-hire). The "Solicit" definition sentence, which supplies the general-advertising and voluntary-inquiry carve-outs, is untouched.
